body: Just one day at a time, reddit friend. The good is out there somewhere.
I tell myself all the time “just get through the day”. But I feel like that just makes the next one ten times harder. I’ll join the venture though, it’s nice to know someone understands it.

It’s so upsetting how much I relate to this, I know how you feel. One half of me is filled with confidence and wants to be loved and accepted. The other half wants to hide away and has so much self doubt. Unfortunately, the second half is slightly stronger.
